title: Pretreatment blood multiomics group summaries by pain outcome after electroacupuncture in breast cancer
design: Exploratory observational, outcome-selected analysis after routine care
sampling: Pretreatment PBMCs and serum from the same six participants
response_definition: BPI-SF worst-pain reduction of at least 2 points by session 16
public_scope: Group-level statistics only; no individual expression columns, raw reads, cell barcodes, sample key or clinical records.
limits: No validation cohort or untreated comparison group.
Cell-level contrasts do not account for donors as independent replication.
Hallmark file contains only three delivered results; complete tested output is unavailable.
A GitHub repository is not a raw sequencing or mass-spectrometry deposit.
